thread:
sam: I opened a small docs PR w/ 3 quick helpers for air-gapped onprem installs: nftables ordering note, a socat debug bridge for unix-socket KMS proxies, and a systemd RequiresMountsFor drop-in to avoid bundle race. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 (WIP).

nina: paste snippets? I will sanity-check commands.

sam: systemd drop-in:
```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-install.service.d/wait-offline.conf
[Unit]
RequiresMountsFor=/mnt/offline-bundle
After=network-online.target
[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/test -d /mnt/offline-bundle
```

sam: nftables note: ensure host-forward rules are applied before kube-proxy nat; example verify: `sudo nft list ruleset` and `sudo conntrack -L | wc -l`.

sam: socat bridge (debug only):
```
socat UNIX-LISTEN:/var/run/redwood-kms/proxy.sock,fork,mode=660 TCP-LISTEN:8200,reuseaddr
# curl --unix-socket /var/run/redwood-kms/proxy.sock http://localhost/health
```
evas: add warning: bridge for local debugging only; recommend systemd socket activation for persistent needs.

nina: SDK snippets? keep tiny, env-first.

sam: added JS and Go small examples that prefer REDWOOD_KMS_TOKEN env then fall back to KMS_SOCKET_PATH.

evas: note: avoid hardcoded lib paths for PKCS#11; add `find / -name "libpkcs11*" 2>/dev/null` tip and `pkcs11-tool --module $MODULE -L`.

infra-bot: PR 412 CI: spellcheck OK, linkcheck warning for external vendor docs, preview pending.

sam: thanks — Nina/Evas please review when free. kept thread short per docs guidelines. :shipit:
